rubrics.justification: It correctly recognizes a very poor-quality blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and TE, but it misstates the Gardner expansion definition, introduces unsupported visual details, and overclaims certainty from the image.
It integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness well, though some links to embryo morphology are somewhat speculative.

The overall logic is structured, but there are inconsistencies such as calling the embryo non-viable/universally non-transferable while also discussing implantation probability, and some conclusions are stronger than the evidence supports.

Much of the counseling and future planning is broadly evidence-based, but stating that 1DD embryos are universally non-transferable and recommending broad RIF/RPL testing from this single embryo assessment goes beyond standard guideline nuance.
Provides clear next steps for counseling, reconsidering transfer, and future workup/planning, though some recommendations are overly broad rather than tightly prioritized for this case.
